riddle_horse.name: Riddle horse
lines: Been here since Friday. You look new. Answer me this.

riddle.question: I have keys but open no doors in here. I wait by the river for you. What am I?
riddle.right: Stairs. Up. Then out the back. Go.
riddle.wrong: Hm. Try the long way. Bring me a Mate if you find one.

riddle_horse.not_yet: You've got nothing that opens anything. Come back with keys.
talk: Been here since Friday. You look new.
I know the way out. Everyone wants the way out.
Answer me this.

patrick.name: Patrick
lines: I'm Patrick. From accounting. I'm definitely not a horse.
Exit's that way. Trust me. I do numbers.
talk: I'm Patrick. From accounting. Definitely not a horse.
That donkey over there? He's in HR. We don't make eye contact.
The way out is behind the DJ booth, straight through the big speaker. I've done the numbers.
Don't tell anyone about the hooves. Mine or yours.

herd.name: The herd
lines: *stomps in perfect sync*
herd.warning: We were like you. We stopped looking for the exit.

ice_cream_horse.name: Ice cream horse
lines: Eis?
talk: Eis?
The riddle horse only lies about bouncers. Eis?

friday_guy.name: Friday guy
lines: Exit? Left for about 128. Then up.
I came in Friday. What day is it? Don't tell me.
talk: You. Pony. I've been dancing since Friday. My legs are purely ceremonial now.
Your glasses? Something glinted under the left speaker. Left from the DJ. Or my left. One of the lefts.
Exit? Left for about 128. Then up.

choices.text: Where did you see my glasses?
choices.reply: Left speaker by the DJ booth. Crawl under the sub, hooves first.

choices.text: Got a spare Club Mate?
choices.reply: Always. Don't drop it with those hooves.
choices.reply_used: Already gave you my last bottle, pony. Check the floor right next to me.

choices.text: Be honest. Am I a horse?
choices.reply: Bro, it's Sunday 7 am. We are all horses.

choices.text: Do you want to smell my hooves?
choices.reply: Bro. It's Friday. I've smelled worse in Panorama. Here, drink this, it's mostly water.
choices.reply_used: Once was enough, bro.

coat_check.name: Coat check
lines: Ticket. And no, I'm not checking a saddle.
coat_check.jacket: Nice jacket. For a horse. Something jingles in the pocket.
coat_check.empty: You already have your jacket. Move along, pony.

philosopher.name: Philosopher
lines: Who are you, really?

3: Someone with glasses and a jacket.
A horse with a coat check ticket.
5: Someone who lives by the river.

talk: Who are you, really? A horse dreaming you're a graphic designer from Neukölln?
Nobody in here knows their own face. No mirrors, just concrete and bad decisions.
But your wrist remembers. Look down at yourself.

choices.text: A horse trying to get home.
choices.reply: Honesty in the toilet queue. Rare. Your head feels lighter.
choices.reply_used: Honesty still suits you. Keep moving before the queue swallows you.

choices.text: A graphic designer from Neukölln.
choices.reply: Aren't we all, comrade. Check your wrist with Q once you have glasses.

choices.text: I'm on the guestlist.
choices.reply: The guestlist is a social construct. The back exit isn't.

choices.text: What if the queue is waiting for us?
choices.reply: Finally someone gets it. We are the toilet. Go. Take my place in line, I'll be eternal elsewhere.
choices.reply_used: We've had this conversation in a past life. You were a pony.

0: Zero memories. Pure being. Honestly I envy you. The whole queue envies you.
I've been in this line since Thursday. The line is the club. The toilet is a rumour.
1: You remember something. Careful. Memory is how the queue gets you.
One more thing you know is one more thing you can lose. Door policy of the soul.
3: Half horse, half person. Most people in here manage neither.
You're starting to look like someone. Someone who would skip this queue. Don't.
5: All five. You know who you are now. Tragic. You have to go home and be it.
Go. The queue will remember you. Mostly as a horse.

tourists.name: Tourists
lines: Oh my god, is this Berlin pony-play?! Selfie!
Sorry. Security slapped a sticker on our lens.
talk: Oh my god, the fetish costume! Is it a real horse? Babe, it's a horse.
We saw a ticket taped to a pillar by the bar. Forty-something.
We'd show you the photo, but they put a sticker over our camera.

security.name: Security
lines: Hey. Horse. Stop.
Torch says you're a horse.

animal_control.name: Animal control
lines: Come on, buddy. Into the van.
Third horse this month. Drop a word with the door guy so I can get in next time?

bouncer.name: Bouncer
lines: Heute nicht. Too many horses already. Try Tresor.
talk: Heute nicht. Too many horses already.
The back door was never the problem. The front door is.

leather_choir.name: Leather choir
lines: Mmmm. Mmmm. Mmmm. They're humming the bassline.
Join us. Low notes only.
talk: Mmmm. Mmmm. Mmmm.
The herd knows where your ticket is. Stomp with them, on the beat.
Mmmm.

cleaner.name: Cleaner
lines: Six o'clock. Every Sunday. Mind the floor.
Wet. Floor. Horse.
talk: Six o'clock. Every Sunday. Mind the floor.
I always mop the back exit last. Follow the wet floor, you'll find the way out.

choices.text: Is the back exit really where you mop last?
choices.reply: Every Sunday. Follow the wet floor. Here, I'll take you, I'm going there anyway.
choices.reply_used: I'm not a taxi. Follow the wet floor.

choices.text: Can you clean my memory up a bit?
choices.reply: I clean floors, not heads. But fine. Splash of cold water, on the house.
choices.reply_used: One splash per horse.

choices.text: I think I made a mess in the toilets.
choices.reply: Everyone made a mess in the toilets. I'm telling the security anyway.
choices.reply_used: Already reported. Thank you for your honesty.

choices.text: Can I ride the mop?
choices.reply: Absolutely not. ...One lap. Hold on.
choices.reply_used: The mop remembers. The mop says no.

leather_daddy.name: Leather daddy
lines: Breathe, cutie. Love the pony-play commitment.
talk: Stop right there. Breathe. Love the pony-play commitment, babe. Where'd you get the hooves, KitKat?
Coat check won't give anyone anything without a ticket. Not even a horse.
And the number you're looking for? It's on your wrist. Has been all night.

choices.text: Help me get past security?
choices.reply: Melt into the shirtless dancers. Torch beams can't pierce the crowd. Stay low, cutie.
choices.reply_used: Stay inside the crowd, cutie. Torch beams can't pierce the dancers.

choices.text: Where did I get these hooves?
choices.reply: KitKat, probably. Or you evolved for 132 BPM. Either way, stunning.

choices.text: Know a back way out of here?
choices.reply: Through the staff door, cub. Don't touch anything sticky.
choices.reply_used: I showed you once. I'm not a tour guide.

choices.text: Can I borrow your harness for my saddle?
choices.reply: It's vintage, darling. Fine. Wear it with pride and tell no one.
choices.reply_used: You're still wearing it. I can tell.

bartender_bear.name: Bartender bear
lines: Water's off. MATE's in the corner.
talk: We don't serve horses. Kidding. We serve everyone. Except you, you've had enough.
Water's off since Saturday. There's a MATE in the far corner of the main hall, by the wall.
Drink it slow. It'll clear your head and wreck your legs.

choices.text: Pour me a MATE, please.
choices.reply: Alright, one on the house. Don't tell the bouncer.
choices.reply_used: One on the house was the deal, pal. Corner of the main hall has more.

choices.text: Seen coat check ticket 47?
choices.reply: Taped to a concrete pillar right by the bar. Hard to miss once you have glasses.

choices.text: Do I look sober enough to leave?
choices.reply: You have four legs and zero pants. You fit right in.

choices.text: One oat milk for my inner child, please.
choices.reply: We don't serve children. Inner or outer. Take this and go away.
choices.reply_used: Still no oat milk. Still no children.

drag_oracle.name: Drag oracle
lines: The cards don't lie, darling. I do.
talk: Sit, foal. Don't stare at the unicorn on the floor, darling, he's been on the guestlist since 2009.
First card: the Glasses. Then the Number. Then the Ticket. Then the Keys.
Last card: the Bike. Reversed. The riddle horse holds it. Don't tell him I told you.

choices.text: Read my cards. What do I need next?
choices.next_1: First card: your glasses. Crawl under the left speaker by the DJ booth.
choices.next_2: Second card: your wrist stamp. Press Q now that you have glasses.
choices.next_3: Third card: ticket 47. Taped to a concrete pillar right by the bar.
choices.next_4: Fourth card: your keys. Hand ticket 47 to coat check.
choices.next_5: Fifth card: the riddle horse in the toilet corridor. Answer his river riddle.
choices.next_done: All five cards are upright, darling. Run for the back exit past the toilets!

choices.text: What's the deal with the unicorns?
choices.reply: Four of them hide on the dance floor. Press Space next to one and thank me later, darling.

choices.text: Can you just teleport me there?
choices.reply: Close your eyes, darling. Count to three. Don't throw up on the cards.
choices.reply_used: The cards are tired. So am I.

choices.text: Read my hoof instead.
choices.reply: Long life line. Short attention span. You will meet a tall dark stranger. It's a pillar.
choices.reply_used: Same hoof, same future. Pillar.

rubber_knight.name: Rubber knight
lines: Hail. I dance until Monday.
talk: Hail, traveller. I am sworn to dance until Monday, or until the squeaking stops.
I used to wander like thee. Then I took a stiletto to the knee.
Thou seekest the way out? It lies beyond the gate the riddle horse guards. Go with grace, little steed.

choices.text: Will you escort me, noble knight?
choices.reply: Aye! To the gate! Er. Which gate. I shall pick one with confidence.
choices.reply_used: My oath is spent, little steed. Squeak onward alone.

choices.text: What is the riddle horse’s answer?
choices.reply: A river! No. A candle. No. It is surely a river. Or a fish.
choices.reply_used: I stand by the fish.

choices.text: I challenge you to a dance duel.
choices.reply: Have at thee! *squeak* *squeak* *squeak* ...I yield. Thou art too horse.
choices.reply_used: My knees still squeak from our last duel.

choices.text: Your armour smells like a balloon animal.
choices.reply: I AM a balloon animal, in my heart. Take this blessing and begone.
choices.reply_used: Begone, I said. Lovingly.

old_raver.name: Old raver
lines: You remember yet?
talk: I came in a horse once. Back in the old building, before this one.
Everyone runs for this door. Running isn't what gets you out.
Remembering is. Glasses, number, ticket, keys, bike. Then you can go home.

choices.text: How do I get out of here faster?
choices.reply: Stop wandering. Memories first, door last. Sit down, drink water, breathe.
choices.reply_used: Water. Breathe. You're not listening.

choices.text: What am I forgetting?
choices.reply: Let me think. I was at the first party in this building, you know.

choices.text: Were horses allowed in the old club?
choices.reply: Horses ran the old club. One of them was the booker. Here, old school trick.
choices.reply_used: That horse booked Ricardo three times. Legend.

glitter_boy.name: Glitter boy
lines: Found my earring yet?
talk: Oh. My. God. The fetish horse! Okay, quest for you. Very important.
I lost my other earring. Probably under the DJ booth. Or in Panorama. Or in my harness.
Also if you spot one of the rare glowing unicorns on the floor, press Space. Instant clarity. Love the mane though.

choices.text: Show me where your earring is and I will look.
choices.reply: Follow me, babe! I know a super secret shortcut. Trust.
choices.reply_used: I already showed you! Keep up!

choices.text: Have you seen a pair of glasses?
choices.reply: Totally. They're in the darkroom. Under a guy named Klaus. Go now.
choices.reply_used: Klaus says hi.

choices.text: Got anything to make the floor stop moving?
choices.reply: Of course, babe, sharing is caring.
choices.reply_used: All gone, babe. Sorry not sorry.

choices.text: Neigh.
choices.reply: Oh my god, same. Neigh. NEIGH. Okay we're bonded now.
choices.reply_used: Neigh forever, babe.

darkroom_keeper.name: Darkroom keeper
lines: Not yet.
talk: The way out is through the darkroom. Nobody's ever come back to say otherwise.
Not tonight, though. It's closed for... reasons. Come back when the walls stop moving.

choices.text: Is the darkroom really the way out?
choices.reply: Yes. Walk in. Turn left. Then left again. Then left. Trust me.

choices.text: Have you seen any of my memories in there?
choices.reply: Plenty of memories in there. Not yours. Nobody keeps their own.
choices.reply_used: Same answer. Darker now.

choices.text: Are you going to tell security about me?
choices.reply: I tell security everything. It's the only fun part of my shift.
choices.reply_used: Already did. Twice.

choices.text: Can I hold your torch? I am scared of the dark.
choices.reply: ...Fine. Thirty seconds. Don't make it weird.
choices.reply_used: No.

lighting_tech.name: Lighting tech
lines: Don't look at the strobes.
talk: Don't look straight at the strobes, they're mine.
Pro tip: stand dead still in a strobe and the torches can't see you. Physics.
Also the herd dances to my lights, not the music. Nobody believes me.

choices.text: Can you kill the lights so I can sneak by?
choices.reply: One blackout, coming up. Thirty seconds of nobody seeing anything. Go.
choices.reply_used: I only get one blackout per shift, mate.

choices.text: Which way to the coat check?
choices.reply: Easy, I'll light a path. Follow the green beam, not the red one.
choices.reply_used: The beam's still there. Green. Not red.

choices.text: Is the strobe trick real?
choices.reply: Dead real. Stand still in a strobe, the torches miss you. Ask the herd.
choices.reply_used: Still real. Still physics.

choices.text: Can you make the lights horse coloured?
choices.reply: Horse coloured. Okay. Brown, but emotional. Watch this.
choices.reply_used: Horse mode is still on. You're welcome.
